error_contract.domain_errors: Existing RECAP_* and other domain error codes are preserved.
error_contract.mcp: Tool failures are tools/call results with isError=true; malformed JSON-RPC requests remain protocol errors.

pagination_contract.arguments: offset and limit; retain filters and recap ranking_revision when continuing
pagination_contract.compaction: Result and request compaction defer whole trailing items with truncated=true. JSON records and nested evidence stay whole; if a request cannot fit a single complete item, it fails with AI_CONTEXT_LIMIT.
pagination_contract.completion: Follow non-null next_offset even on an empty page. A full last page may require one empty probe. null ends the current result set except end_reason=offset_limit, which requires a narrower query.
pagination_contract.consistency: Offsets require unchanged filters and data. Recap ranking_revision rejects changed rankings; other tools should be restarted after source or index changes.
pagination_contract.positions: result_offset refers to the row before privacy filtering; next_offset is the next unread position, not offset plus returned_count
pagination_contract.results: items (ocr_results for snapshot details), offset, limit, returned_count, next_offset; total only when known

time_contract.calendar: Recap dates retain their recorded time zone and absolute day/period boundaries. Inspect calendar on a day, or calendars[date] on date lists and search results. Legacy days use rule=recorded_bounds with time_zone=null.

tools.description: Page screenshot metadata in the half-open interval [start_ms, end_ms), ordered by capture time then screenshot_id. Results use screenshot_id and captured_at_ms (Unix milliseconds); null capture time means unknown. Use offset/limit; max_records is a legacy alias for limit. Pages return items (ocr_results for details), offset, limit, returned_count and next_offset. Follow next_offset with unchanged filters even after a short/empty page; never advance by returned_count or limit. Agent truncation preserves the next unread position. result_offset counts rows before privacy filtering. null ends this result set unless end_reason=offset_limit; then narrow the query. Restart after source/index changes.

Date is YYYY-MM-DD in the returned calendar, whose recorded time zone and day/period boundaries remain fixed. Sources use screenshot_id and captured_at_ms; all instants are Unix milliseconds. tools.description: Search saved, corrected daily recap activities across dates using keywords, local text meaning, or both. Date filters are inclusive saved YYYY-MM-DD labels; inspect calendars[date] for recorded zones and boundaries. process_names matches any cited source, case-insensitively. Sources use screenshot_id and captured_at_ms. Verify factual claims with get_snapshot_details. Hybrid searches all filtered activities by keyword and uses available vectors even with a partial index; unavailable semantics leave keyword results. coverage reports unique text chunks and activity coverage globally, in the query scope, and per scoped date; missing_chunks identifies dates with gaps. execution reports requested mode, executed branches, pre-pagination match counts, fallback reason and the semantic top-200 candidate cap. total counts fused candidates, not all possible semantic matches. index_progress reports index construction separately. A null keyword_rank means the activity did not match keywords. Does not generate recaps or build the index. Pages return items (ocr_results for details), offset, limit, returned_count and next_offset. Follow next_offset with unchanged filters even after a short/empty page; never advance by returned_count or limit. Agent truncation preserves the next unread position. result_offset counts rows before privacy filtering. null ends this result set unless end_reason=offset_limit; then narrow the query. Restart after source/index changes.
